summary: Created at the user's request: mask detection (Detect/Points/Text) dispatches a ComfyUI workflow with no onProgress, so it never reaches the queue or the StatusBar bar. Long detects read as a hang.

Noted from the MPI-424 brainstorm: unchanged in substance, but after MPI-425 the three detect engines sit behind ONE Detect button, so this card instruments and caches one panel's dispatch path rather than three. Independent of the umbrella order.

Filed under the MPI-440 canvas-family umbrella #2 (mask and paint parity). Order, standing constraints and the shared alpha-vs-luminance decision are in tasks/MPI-440/brief.md - read it before starting this card.

todo -> doing. Next member of the MPI-440 umbrella after MPI-426 shipped. Investigation done: the graph's ImpactSEGSPicker is the ONLY reason a chip toggle re-dispatches, and MaskManager already holds Map<index,bitmap> + a selected Set, so the cache is a graph rewire plus a client toggle.

Built. Graph: ImpactSEGSPicker deleted from both workflow twins, so one detect returns every object's mask (live proof on 48188: 4 thumbs / 4 masks; the pre-change graph returned 1). Client: chip toggling is a local composite, detect drives the status bar as a utility lane and the Detect button becomes Stop. 396 tests pass. Renderer half still needs an in-app pass - steps in validation.md.

User-validated in the app: DETECTING bar with a clock, chips composited from ONE detect with no re-dispatch, Stop working, Add unchanged. Two bugs found during that pass and fixed first - the Stop button had deleted Detect (mount() replaces innerHTML) and progress.cancel() never cleared the indeterminate pulse. Commits 1028b958, bec47363, 2ed85e70. 400 tests pass.
